questions.q_en: Five people M, N, O, P and Q gave typing test. O took more time than N and P. Q took less time than M and P. M took more time than O. More than three person took more time than N. How many person(s) took less time than M?
questions.solution_en:
Five people M, N, O, P and Q gave typing test.

O took more time than N and P. So, O > N/P

Q took less time than M and P. So, M/P > Q

M took more time than O. So, M > O > N/P > Q or M > O > P > Q > N

More than three person took more time than N.

Thus, we get:

M > O > P > Q > N.

Thus, four persons took less time than M.

T > R > P > U > S
